questions.prompt: In order to _____ the budget for next year, the finance team must review all current expenditures.

questions.explanation: 「安全規則の重大な違反」で violation（違反）が正解。

questions.explanation: 「強い決意をもって対応した」→ determination（決意）が適切。

questions.prompt: It is important to remain _____ to constructive feedback in order to improve performance.
questions.explanation: remain open to ～（～に対して受け入れる姿勢でいる）の定番。

questions.prompt: The regional office was relocated to a new building with better facilities and _____ access to public transportation.
questions.explanation: convenient access（便利なアクセス）が自然。

questions.prompt: All candidates must meet the minimum requirements as _____ in the job posting.
questions.explanation: as outlined in ～（～に概説されている通り）の表現が適切。

questions.prompt: Management is considering whether to expand the facility or _____ production to another site.
questions.explanation: 「生産を別拠点へ移す」→ transfer が正解。

questions.prompt: In her new role, Ms. Grant will be _____ for overseeing international partnerships.
questions.explanation: be responsible for ～（～を担当する）の定型。

questions.prompt: The updated privacy policy outlines how user data will be stored and _____ securely.
questions.explanation: 「保存され安全に取り扱われる」→ handled が自然。

questions.explanation: procedures を修飾する形容詞が必要で operational（業務の）が適切。

questions.prompt: Each employee is entitled to a one-hour lunch break, _____ of their shift schedule.
questions.explanation: regardless of ～（～に関係なく）の形で文が成立する。

questions.prompt: The instructions were vague, leading to widespread _____.
questions.explanation: 「曖昧な指示で混乱が広がった」→ confusion（混乱）が正解。

questions.prompt: The company’s rapid growth has been attributed to its strong leadership and _____ culture.

questions.explanation: in next week（来週中に）の意味で in が適切。

questions.explanation: positive attitude（前向きな態度）が定番。

questions.prompt: The director decided to _____ the marketing budget to accommodate the new campaign.
questions.explanation: 「新キャンペーンに合わせて予算を調整する」→ adjust。

questions.prompt: Please _____ the revised version of the contract by Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 命令文なので動詞の原形 sign が正解。

questions.explanation: in accordance with（〜に従って）の定型。

questions.explanation: 「履歴書は印象的だったが、カバーレターには十分な詳細がなかった」という流れで、detail（詳細）が自然です。“participation”（参加）などは不自然です。

questions.prompt: In order to ensure compliance, the audit team will _____ the documentation regularly.

questions.prompt: The manager asked the assistant to _____ the updated policy to all staff.

questions.prompt: The venue was chosen not only for its convenience but also for its _____.

questions.prompt: The software has been updated to run more _____ on older operating systems.

questions.prompt: The candidate’s qualifications are _____ to those of the other finalists.
questions.explanation: 「他の最終候補者よりも優れている」という比較の表現にふさわしいのは superior（〜より優れている）です。to という前置詞と一緒に使う語です。

questions.prompt: The finance director expressed concerns regarding the _____ rise in expenses.
questions.explanation: 「頻繁な出費の増加について懸念を示した」という文脈で、frequent（頻繁な）が正解。“excessive”（過度な）や “sudden”（突然の）も文脈次第で正解になり得ますが、ここでは発生頻度が主眼。

questions.prompt: New safety measures were introduced to minimize potential _____.
questions.explanation: 「潜在的なリスクを最小限に抑えるために導入された」という意味で、risks（リスク）が正解。“services” や “options” は意味が異なります。

questions.prompt: The employee was transferred to another location due to a departmental _____.
questions.explanation: 「部門の再構築により異動になった」という流れで、名詞 restructure（再編成）が正解です。

questions.prompt: The legal team reviewed the contract carefully before giving their _____.
questions.explanation: 「契約を承認する前に慎重に精査した」という意味で、approval（承認）が自然です。“evidence”（証拠）や “invitation”（招待）は意味が合いません。

questions.prompt: The policy update includes new procedures for managing _____ files.
questions.explanation: 「機密ファイルを管理する新しい手順を含む」という意味で、confidential（機密の）が正解です。“confident”（自信がある）とは意味が異なります。

questions.prompt: Applicants must provide proof of identity and _____ to be considered.
questions.explanation: 「本人確認と資格の証明を提出しなければならない」という文脈で、qualification（資格）が最も自然です。

questions.prompt: The assistant accidentally deleted the file, but it was quickly _____.
questions.explanation: 「削除してしまったが、すぐに復元された」という文脈で、restored（復元された）が正解です。

questions.prompt: The travel reimbursement request was denied because the receipt was _____.
questions.explanation: 「領収書がなかったために払い戻し請求が却下された」という意味で、missing（紛失している）が適切です。

questions.prompt: Management has decided to _____ operations to reduce overhead costs.
questions.explanation: 「間接費を削減するため業務を合理化する」と言いたいので、streamline（合理化する）が正解です。

questions.prompt: The updated schedule was sent out to avoid any potential _____.
questions.explanation: 「潜在的な衝突（予定の重複など）を避けるために更新されたスケジュールが送られた」という文脈から、conflict（衝突、対立）が正解です。

questions.prompt: The spokesperson declined to comment on the issue until the investigation is _____.
questions.explanation: 「調査が完了するまでコメントを控えた」という意味で、completed（完了した）が最も自然です。

questions.prompt: The mobile application was tested thoroughly before its _____ release.
questions.explanation: 「正式リリース前に十分にテストされた」という文脈から、official（正式な）が正解です。

questions.prompt: The conference will feature industry leaders who are known for their _____.
questions.explanation: 「業界の革新で知られている」という意味で、innovation（革新）が最も適切です。

questions.prompt: Rachel was sorry ------- her brother's opening night performance, but there was no helping it.
questions.explanation: sorry は to 不定詞を従えるため、to have missed が正解です。

questions.prompt: In case of emergency, break the glass and pull ------- the red handle.
questions.explanation: pull down ... で「…を引き下ろす」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: Scientists were researching the possibility that ------- of the precious oil could be used to cure various illnesses.
questions.explanation: 文脈上「抽出物」という意味の名詞 extract が最も適切です。

questions.prompt: With a ------- laugh, Ken agreed with his boss that his new hairstyle was too short.
questions.explanation: laugh を修飾する形容詞が必要で、文脈に合う nervous が正解です。

questions.prompt: The following article may be reprinted for educational purposes, provided ------- the source is clearly named.
questions.explanation: provided that ... で「…という条件で」という熟語です。

questions.prompt: The most reliable stock portfolio consists ------- low-risk investments in a variety of well established industries.
questions.explanation: consist of ... で「…で構成される」という意味です。

questions.prompt: When Tom lost his job suddenly, he was worried that his ------- savings would not support him and his family for long.
questions.explanation: 文脈から「わずかな貯金」という意味になる small が適切です。

questions.prompt: The president announced that Ms. Simms ------- the post of vice-president in charge of sales in three weeks.
questions.explanation: in three weeks は未来を表し、過去から見た未来なので would assume が正解です。

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, there was one reason people fail to achieve their goals, -------, lack of motivation.
questions.explanation: 後半は前の one reason の具体的内容なので、「すなわち」の namely が入ります。

questions.prompt: Officials refused to say exactly who was ------- for the tragic accident before the investigation was complete.
questions.explanation: be responsible for ... で「…に責任がある」という意味です。

questions.prompt: In a case of ------- identity, security staff at the airport detained the company president for four hours.
questions.explanation: mistaken identity で「人違い」という決まった表現です。

questions.prompt: When the debate became heated, Mr. Ferrell suggested that the group ------- a short break to cool down.
questions.explanation: suggest の後の節では動詞の原形が使われるため take が正解です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Schneider asked the kitchen supervisor how many lunches ------- for the students’ field trip.
questions.explanation: lunches が作られる対象なので、受動態の had been made が適切です。

questions.prompt: In order to smooth the ------- into the new headquarters, a floor plan of the building was distributed to all employees.
questions.explanation: the と into の間には名詞が入り、「移行」を表す transition が正解です。

questions.prompt: Flint, Inc. was able to make products that were only ------- popular among domestic customers bestsellers overseas.
questions.explanation: only と popular の流れから「ほどほどに」の moderately が自然です。

questions.prompt: After hours of consideration, Peter finally ------- up with a catchy name for the new product.
questions.explanation: come up with ... で「…を思いつく」という意味です。

questions.prompt: When Judy told Dan that she created the game software -------, he didn't quite believe her.
questions.explanation: 「自分自身で」と強調するには herself を使います。

questions.prompt: Needing relief from the issues ------- heavily on her mind, Betty made an appointment for a massage at a local spa.
questions.explanation: issues を後ろから修飾する分詞句なので weighing が適切です。

questions.prompt: The director didn’t normally give newcomers leading role in his movies, but he made an ------- in his upcoming film.
questions.explanation: make an exception で「例外とする」という熟語です。

questions.prompt: Although the fans poured into the stadium with great enthusiasm, the game was ------- due to heavy rain.
questions.explanation: due to heavy rain から、「延期された」を表す postponed が適切です。

questions.prompt: The teacher tried to show her students how mathematics can be ------- to various real-world situations.
questions.explanation: mathematics が「応用される」側なので applied が正解です。

questions.prompt: Though Mr. Thomas made an ------- effort to save the company from bankruptcy, he finally had to admit it was hopeless.
questions.explanation: make an effort に自然につながり、文意にも合う admirable が適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- having extensive experience in personnel management, Ms. Ridley also worked in sales for nearly ten years.
questions.explanation: 「…に加えて」という意味で Besides が最も適切です。

questions.prompt: The popular coffee shop chain made the decision to ------- all of its cafes with wireless Internet.
questions.explanation: equip X with Y で「X に Y を備え付ける」という意味です。

questions.prompt: After choosing Michael as team leader, the manager gave him a ------- overview of the project.
questions.explanation: overview を修飾する形容詞が必要なので comprehensive が正解です。

questions.prompt: The senator has never held a press conference, and has ------- been asked to answer a question.
questions.explanation: never と意味の流れが合う「めったに…ない」の seldom が適切です。

questions.prompt: In ------- to your letter dated June 17, we're sorry that we cannot comply with your request.
questions.explanation: in regard to ... で「…に関しては」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Due to concerns about side effects, the federal drug safety department has delayed its ------- of the new medication.
questions.explanation: its と of の間なので名詞が必要で、approval が入ります。

questions.prompt: The roads were slippery with ice, but Jeannie was confident that her car had ------- snow tires.
questions.explanation: 凍結した道路に合う「適切な」という意味の adequate が自然です。

questions.prompt: The politician came out in support ------- the plan to renovate all public schools in the city within five years.
questions.explanation: in support of ... で「…を支持して」という表現です。

questions.prompt: Though the injury healed more quickly than doctors expected, ------- three months Jim was still walking with a limp.
questions.explanation: three months という期間を自然に導けるのは after です。

questions.prompt: During the presentation, Jason avoided ------- to his notes since he wanted to impress the audience.
questions.explanation: avoid は動名詞を従えるため、referring が正解です。

questions.prompt: The company’s new computers were all ------- by highly secure, anti-viral software.
questions.explanation: 「ソフトによって保護されていた」という意味になる protected が適切です。

questions.prompt: We reserve the right to raise the prices on all of our products ------- the cost of raw materials goes up.
questions.explanation: 「原料費が上がるときはいつでも」という意味になる whenever が文意に合います。

questions.prompt: The contest sponsored by the regional government is open to ------- living in the tri-county area.
questions.explanation: 「その地域に住んでいる人ならだれでも」という意味になる anyone が適切です。

questions.prompt: Mary was praised by the president for her ------- solution to the problem.
questions.explanation: solution を修飾する形容詞が必要なので inventive が正解です。

questions.prompt: You can call this number for assistance from the security firm in case of -------.
questions.explanation: in case of emergency で「緊急時には」という決まった表現です。

questions.prompt: The new government is planning to ban companies ------- selling their products below cost.
questions.explanation: ban X from Y で「XがYすることを禁じる」という形です。

questions.prompt: The Department of Natural Resources is committed to investigating citizen reports of illegal ------- of solid waste.
questions.explanation: illegal dumping of solid waste で「固形廃棄物の不法投棄」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: According to Joanna, Mark Richards, the former sales chief, has been out of ------- for nearly three years.
questions.explanation: out of touch で「連絡が取れない、音信不通で」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Lawmaker Wayne Jones has been criticized for his actions that are contrary ------- his campaign promises.
questions.explanation: contrary to ... で「…に反して」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: As he ------- his report last Friday, Andrew is able to help his colleagues this week.
questions.explanation: last Friday という過去の時を表す語があるので、過去形が適切です。

questions.prompt: The signs posted in all of the cars discourage passengers from using ------- cell phones while riding the train.
questions.explanation: passengers を受ける複数の所有格が必要なので their が正解です。

questions.prompt: The new employee, with his experience living abroad, provided valuable ------- to dealing with the international clients.
questions.explanation: provide valuable insight to ... で「…に関する貴重な見識を与える」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Each of the partners ------- a stake in the company, so it is essential that they stay on top of the ongoing investigation.
questions.explanation: 主語は Each なので単数扱いとなり、has が正解です。

questions.prompt: Bonnie was tall with dark curly hair, ------- her younger sister was a short blond-headed child.
questions.explanation: 前後が対照的な内容なので whereas が適切です。

questions.prompt: After trying on more than a dozen dresses, Jessica finally decided on one that was ------- for the awards ceremony.
questions.explanation: was の後には形容詞が必要なので suitable が入ります。

questions.prompt: Though it had been ten years since her move, Karen ------- felt nostalgic when she drove by her former house.
questions.explanation: 「10年たってもまだ」という流れなので still が自然です。

questions.prompt: In all parts of the airplane, including the lavatories, smoking is strictly -------.
questions.explanation: be strictly prohibited で「厳しく禁止されている」という意味です。

questions.prompt: For ------- we know, the president could be planning to merge with TC Corp. before the end of the quarter.
questions.explanation: for all we know で「私たちの知る限りでは」という熟語です。

questions.prompt: The author read an ------- from his latest work, then signed customers’ books at a table in the back of the store.
questions.explanation: excerpt は「抜粋」という意味で、read an excerpt が自然です。

questions.prompt: We will not be able to proceed with the investigation ------- the proper paperwork has been filed with your insurance provider.
questions.explanation: 「…するまでは」を表す until が適切です。

questions.prompt: It's essential to measure the ingredients for this dish ------- in order to make it delicious.
questions.explanation: measure を修飾する副詞が必要なので precisely が正解です。

questions.prompt: The president said that going ahead with this project could end up ------- the company's credibility.
questions.explanation: undermine someone's credibility で「…の信用を傷つける」という意味です。

questions.prompt: The committee asked all applicants to submit ------- resumes before the deadline.
questions.explanation: applicants を受ける所有格が必要なので their が正解です。

questions.prompt: No one at the reception desk seemed ------- of the schedule change for the afternoon meeting.
questions.explanation: seem aware of ... で「…を知っているようだ」という形になります。

questions.prompt: To reduce shipping costs, the company decided to ------- its packaging materials.
questions.explanation: decided to の後は動詞の原形が必要なので revise が正解です。

questions.prompt: The restaurant received several complaints because the soup was served -------.
questions.explanation: served の補語として形容詞が必要なので cold が適切です。

questions.prompt: If the weather improves by noon, the event will be held ------- as planned.
questions.explanation: 天候が良くなれば「屋外で」開催される、という文脈なので outdoors が自然です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Carter was promoted after she ------- outstanding leadership throughout the project.
questions.explanation: after 以下は過去の出来事を述べているので、過去形 demonstrated が適切です。

questions.prompt: The equipment is ______ for staff use after they complete the required safety training.
questions.explanation: be動詞の後ろには補語となる形容詞が必要なので、available が正解です。

questions.prompt: The process was explained ______ detail, allowing the trainees to perform their tasks without confusion.
questions.explanation: in detail で「詳細に」という決まった表現です。

questions.prompt: Please ______ to the operations manual before attempting to reset the machine.
questions.explanation: refer to ... で「…を参照する」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: The support team must ______ respond to all inquiries during peak business hours.
questions.explanation: respond という動詞を修飾する副詞が必要なので、quickly が正解です。

questions.prompt: The new product line was ______ anticipated by loyal customers across the country.
questions.explanation: anticipated を自然に修飾し、文意にも合うのは eagerly です。

questions.prompt: ______ the report was late, the manager appreciated its thorough analysis and clear recommendations.
questions.explanation: 前後が逆接の関係なので、「…にもかかわらず」を表す Although が適切です。

questions.prompt: Her presentation included ______ improvements that greatly enhanced the overall clarity and visual appeal.
questions.explanation: improvements を自然に修飾し、文意にも合うのは subtle です。

questions.prompt: ______ employees attended the seminar on workplace safety and submitted the required feedback form.
questions.explanation: employees の前にそのまま置けるのは Most です。Almost と Nearly の後ろには通常数詞などが必要です。

questions.prompt: The manager refused to blame the delay ______ the interns, since the instructions were unclear.
questions.explanation: blame A on B で「AをBのせいにする」という表現です。

questions.prompt: The decision to hire a new consultant was ______ among all department heads.
questions.explanation: decision に合い、文意も自然なのは unanimous「全員一致の」です。

questions.prompt: It is ______ that the meeting will be rescheduled due to the manager’s unexpected absence.
questions.explanation: It is likely that ... で「…しそうだ、…の可能性が高い」という形になります。

questions.prompt: The shipment was delayed ______ severe weather conditions affecting transportation across multiple regions.
questions.explanation: severe weather conditions は名詞句なので、前置詞句の due to が適切です。

questions.prompt: The ______ of the training is to improve communication and efficiency in cross-functional teams.
questions.explanation: 文全体の意味から「目的」を表す objective が最も適切です。

questions.prompt: The team handled customer complaints in a professional______, ensuring every concern was addressed respectfully.
questions.explanation: in a professional fashion で「プロフェッショナルなやり方で」という自然な表現になります。

questions.prompt: The CEO, ______ with the board members, announced the company’s new sustainability initiative.
questions.explanation: together with ... で「…と一緒に」という表現になるため、together が正解です。

questions.prompt: It is highly ______ that the new vendor can meet our production deadlines without extra resources.
questions.explanation: It is highly doubtful that ... で「…は大いに疑わしい」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: Customers often ______ product quality with the reputation of the brand behind it.
questions.explanation: 主語が Customers で一般的事実を述べているので、動詞の原形 associate が適切です。

questions.prompt: The manager outlined the ______ steps required after the initial project approval was granted.
questions.explanation: 「その後の段階」を表す形容詞 subsequent が文意に合います。

questions.prompt: They submitted ______ their reports before the end of the day to meet the internal deadline.
questions.explanation: all their reports で「彼らの報告書をすべて」という意味になり、語順も自然です。

questions.prompt: According to company______ , employees are not allowed to accept gifts from suppliers.
questions.explanation: according to company policy で「会社の方針によると」という自然な表現です。

questions.prompt: The volume of customer complaints began to _____ the small customer service department.
questions.explanation: 苦情の量が部署に「負担をかけすぎる」という意味で overwhelm が適切です。

questions.prompt: ______ next month, all employees will need to use a new login system for security.
questions.explanation: As of next month で「来月から」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: The software subscription costs as ______ as $10 per month for small businesses with basic needs.
questions.explanation: as little as ... で「わずか…」という意味の表現です。

questions.prompt: The meeting room remained ______ for hours after the team moved to the main conference hall.
questions.explanation: 会議室が「空いていた」という意味になる unoccupied が適切です。

questions.prompt: ______ you have any questions about the policy, please contact the human resources department immediately.
questions.explanation: Should you have any questions ... は丁寧な倒置で、「もし質問がありましたら」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Employees have an ______ to report safety hazards to their supervisors immediately.
questions.explanation: have an obligation to ... で「…する義務がある」という表現です。

questions.prompt: The team must finish the task today;______, the client may cancel the contract entirely.
questions.explanation: 「さもないと」という意味で、前文を受ける otherwise が最も適切です。

questions.prompt: The assistant created a ______ file to ensure no data was lost during the update.
questions.explanation: データ消失を防ぐための「複製ファイル」という意味で duplicate が適切です。

questions.prompt: The supervisor asked me to print ______ financial documents before the end of the day.
questions.explanation: 複数形の financial documents を修飾でき、文意にも合うのは the other です。

questions.prompt: The data shows a major error, ______ a complete failure of the new system.
questions.explanation: if not ... で「そうでなければ、少なくとも…」という意味になり、文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: Any employees who have signed up can ------- in the dinner party next Friday.
questions.explanation: participate in ... で「…に参加する」という表現なので、participate が正解です。

questions.prompt: If you want to ------- to an independent agent nearest you, just click "Find My Agent" on the menu bar.
questions.explanation: 文脈上「最寄りの代理店担当者に話す」が自然なので、talk が適切です。

questions.prompt: The typhoon affected ------- 2 million people in China, with about 900,000 of them evacuated from their homes.
questions.explanation: 数字の前に置いて「…より多い」を表す more than が正解です。

questions.prompt: A group of volunteers founded an NPO to support the unemployed and provide them with the ------- to live.
questions.explanation: the means to live で「生活の手段」という意味になるため、means が適切です。

questions.prompt: In an effort to reduce expenses, Whitman Film Co. has decided to halve its production ------- for the upcoming year.
questions.explanation: halve its production costs で「生産コストを半減する」という自然な表現です。

questions.prompt: Please be aware that ------- handling fees may be required for international mail orders.
questions.explanation: handling fees を修飾し、文意にも合うのは additional「追加の」です。

questions.prompt: Through its globally linked network, the Hutchison Group ------- a comprehensive range of financial services.
questions.explanation: services を「提供する」という意味で provides が最も自然です。

questions.prompt: The project team will have to ------- extensive research before settling on a final plan.
questions.explanation: conduct research で「調査を行う」という決まった表現です。

questions.prompt: While most candidates ------- opportunities to meet voters, they rarely venture beyond the safety of their own communities.
questions.explanation: seek opportunities で「機会を求める」という意味になるので seek が正解です。

questions.prompt: An R&D project of new product lineups is in ------- in order to expand to foreign markets.
questions.explanation: in progress で「進行中で」という意味の熟語になります。

questions.prompt: Signs have been ------- stating that the beaches are closed because of the strong winds.
questions.explanation: signs have been posted で「掲示されている」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: Any employees who have worked at the company for more than three years are ------- to apply for the assistant manager position at the Newport Branch.
questions.explanation: be eligible to apply で「応募資格がある」という意味なので eligible が適切です。

questions.prompt: Sales representatives are encouraged to ------- up with new ideas about advertising strategies.
questions.explanation: come up with ... で「…を思いつく、考え出す」という表現です。

questions.prompt: One of the growing concerns for people who are worried about the earth is the ------- of our air and water.
questions.explanation: air and water の「質」を問題にしているので quality が正解です。

questions.prompt: The city council announced that the reform of its health services would take ------- the following fiscal year.
questions.explanation: take place で「行われる、実施される」という熟語です。

questions.prompt: By State Law, you need a ------- in order to purchase contact lenses.
questions.explanation: コンタクトレンズ購入に必要なのは「処方箋」なので prescription が適切です。

questions.prompt: Cape Clothing Store will have to undergo drastic downsizing due to a long-term economic -------.
questions.explanation: economic downturn で「景気後退」という意味になり、文意に合います。

questions.prompt: Travelers can easily book ------- at the cheapest rate by using a rate comparison tool on Web sites.
questions.explanation: book accommodations で「宿泊施設を予約する」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: Purchased items can be returned to FS Interiors free of ------- if it is within two weeks of purchase.
questions.explanation: free of charge で「無料で」という決まった表現です。

questions.prompt: In order to ------- a group study room in the library, you need to follow the instructions in the student's guidebook.
questions.explanation: room を「予約する」という意味の reserve が適切です。

questions.prompt: We must ensure we meet the ------- by sharing workloads, or we will lose our credibility since competition is becoming fierce.
questions.explanation: meet the deadline で「締め切りに間に合わせる」という表現です。

questions.prompt: Our customers can receive a ------- based on the money-back guarantee.
questions.explanation: money-back guarantee から「返金」を表す refund が正解です。

questions.prompt: The travel agent could not make an automatic ------- of Mr. Smith's travel expenses because the account balance was insufficient.
questions.explanation: account balance が不足していてできないのは「引き落とし」なので withdrawal が適切です。

questions.prompt: The book became a huge commercial success, selling at ------- three million copies worldwide with a profit of over $50 million.
questions.explanation: at least ... で「少なくとも…」という意味になります。

questions.prompt: Diamond Hotel has a fitness facility on the ------- and the guests can work out freely.
questions.explanation: on the premises で「施設内に、敷地内に」という意味の表現です。

questions.prompt: If Mr. Kim had known the duration of the visit to National Museum in -------, he wouldn't have joined the tour.
questions.explanation: in advance で「前もって」という熟語なので advance が正解です。

questions.prompt: The manager is going to ------- permission to recruit a new staff member at the meeting next week.
questions.explanation: permission を「得る」という意味で obtain が最も自然です。

questions.prompt: Ms. Kato pointed ------- a sharp increase in sales at their competitors for the year.
questions.explanation: point out ... で「…を指摘する」という表現です。

questions.prompt: The vice president and his subordinate ------- a visit to Stars Industries for the first time this year.
questions.explanation: pay a visit to ... で「…を訪問する」という熟語になります。

questions.prompt: The first-time patients must ------- a questionnaire about their medical status in this clinic.
questions.explanation: questionnaire を「記入する、完成させる」という意味で complete が適切です。

paragraphs.text: Subject: Reminder About Annual Policy Review
Dear Employees,

This is a reminder that all staff members are required to review the company’s code of conduct and workplace policies before the end of the quarter. The updated policy handbook is available in the HR section of the internal portal.

As cities face rising summer temperatures, more urban planners are turning to green roofs as a sustainable cooling solution. These living rooftops, which are covered in vegetation, help reduce heat absorption, lower building energy costs, and improve air quality. [1] Unlike traditional roofs, they provide insulation that keeps indoor spaces cooler during hot weather and reduces reliance on air conditioning.

Recent studies show that buildings with green roofs can be up to 5°C cooler than those with conventional roofing materials. [2] In addition to temperature regulation, green roofs support biodiversity by creating habitats for pollinators like bees and butterflies. [3] Several major cities have begun offering tax incentives or grants to encourage property owners to invest in this eco-friendly infrastructure. [4]

paragraphs.text: City Council Approves Electric Scooter Trial

In an effort to improve urban mobility and reduce traffic congestion, the Lakeville City Council has approved a six-month trial program allowing electric scooters on designated bike lanes and streets. Beginning June 1, two major scooter rental companies—ZipRide and VoltMotion—will deploy up to 500 shared scooters throughout the downtown area.

The scooters will be equipped with GPS tracking, and users must download a mobile app to unlock and ride. Riders will be required to park scooters in specified zones to prevent sidewalk obstruction. The city will monitor safety, parking behavior, and ridership data during the trial.

Council members emphasized that this pilot is temporary and may be adjusted or suspended based on resident feedback and safety reports. A formal evaluation will be conducted in December to determine whether to make the program permanent.
Reader Comment: Posted by Emily R. on CityNews

I live near one of the proposed deployment zones, and while I like the idea of reducing car usage, I’m not convinced this program has been fully thought through. Have city planners considered how seniors or people with disabilities might be affected if sidewalks become cluttered with parked scooters?
Also, there’s no mention of helmet requirements in the article. I see people zipping around downtown on bikes and scooters with no protection—are we just assuming they’ll ride safely on their own?

Don’t get me wrong, I support green transportation, but it feels like the city is rushing this out without addressing basic safety and accessibility concerns. I hope they take public comments seriously during the review in December.

paragraphs.text: Remote Work Policy Expanded at Vantara Solutions

Vantara Solutions, a global software company based in Seattle, has announced a significant expansion of its remote work policy. Beginning next quarter, all full-time employees in non-customer-facing roles will have the option to work remotely up to four days a week. The decision follows an internal survey where 82% of employees expressed a preference for greater flexibility.

Company executives emphasized that the shift aims to improve work-life balance and employee retention. Managers will still hold weekly virtual check-ins, and staff must be present in-office at least once a week for team-building or project meetings. Employees must also maintain core hours between 10 a.m. and 3 p.m. in their respective time zones.
The new policy will be reviewed after six months to assess its impact on productivity and collaboration. If successful, it may become a permanent option.
Reader Comment: Posted by Jason M.

As a longtime employee at Vantara, I’m glad the company is listening to us. The remote option will be a huge relief for many of us who have long commutes or care responsibilities at home. However, I’m curious how this will affect teams that work across multiple time zones—especially since we’re required to be available during “core hours.” That might not be feasible for everyone.

Also, while the article says there will be virtual check-ins, it doesn’t mention how performance will be measured. Will we be evaluated by output or attendance at meetings? I hope managers are given clear guidelines too—some are great with remote teams, but others may need support adapting.
All in all, this is a great move. I just hope the company commits to transparency during the trial period and considers team feedback in the final review.

This agreement is entered into by Solara Beverages (“Supplier”) and Pinewood Hotels Group (“Client”) and is valid from July 1 to December 31. The Supplier agrees to provide bottled sparkling water to all Pinewood resort locations in Oregon and Washington.

Deliveries will be made on the first Monday of each month, with quantities based on monthly usage reports submitted by the Client. If usage exceeds projections, additional deliveries must be approved in writing.
The agreed unit price is $0.98 per bottle, with payment due within 15 business days of invoice. Late payments may incur a 2% service charge.
The Supplier will also provide branded coolers for each hotel, to be maintained by Pinewood staff. Any damage to the coolers due to staff negligence will be billed separately.
Email – From: Lila Serrano l.serrano@pinewoodhotels.com
To: Delivery Team, Solara Beverages
Subject: October Delivery Request
Dear Solara Team,
I’m writing to request an adjustment to our October delivery. Our Seaside and Timberline locations both had unusually high guest traffic last month and have already depleted their inventory.
We would like to request a mid-month supplemental delivery of 800 bottles to each of those two sites. Please let us know if this request can be approved and delivered by October 16.

Also, we recently noticed condensation buildup in one of the Solara-branded coolers at Timberline. It doesn’t appear to be functioning properly. Could someone inspect or replace it during the next delivery?
We’ve submitted our usual usage report and will await your confirmation.
Best regards,
Lila Serrano
Regional Operations Manager
Monthly Fulfillment Report – Prepared by Solara Logistics Team
Client: Pinewood Hotels Group
Reporting Period: October 1–31

The standard delivery of 6,400 bottles was completed on October 2 across all Oregon and Washington locations. Following an approved request from Pinewood, an additional 1,600 bottles (800 each for Seaside and Timberline) were shipped on October 16.
This extra delivery was authorized by the supply coordination team and billed at the standard rate. Payment for both deliveries was received on time.

No issues were reported with bottle quality or shipment timing. However, the Timberline property reported problems with cooler performance, which was noted for follow-up inspection. A replacement cooler has been scheduled for the November 6 delivery.
Note: Cooler maintenance remains the responsibility of the Client per agreement terms.

サービス契約書（抜粋）

合意された単価は1本あたり0.98ドルで、請求書発行日から15営業日以内に支払うものとします。支払いが遅れた場合は、2%のサービス料が加算される可能性があります。

供給業者は、各ホテルにブランド入りクーラーも提供します。これらのクーラーは Pinewood スタッフが管理し、スタッフの過失による損傷については別途請求されます。

それぞれの施設に800本ずつ、合計1,600本の中旬追加納品を、10月16日までにお願いできないでしょうか。

Lila Serrano

顧客：Pinewood Hotels Group

報告期間：10月1日〜31日

この追加納品は、供給調整チームにより承認され、標準価格で請求されました。両納品分の支払いは期限内に受領されました。

The rollout will be coordinated by the IT department, with assistance from department administrators. Training resources for the new devices will be available through the internal learning portal.
